pageProps.title: Miyoung's Place
pageProps.review: At Miyoung's Place in Daejeong-eup, Seogwipo, Jeju, discover the best Korean restaurant with fresh mackerel sashimi that isn't fishy, seasoned rice, and a spicy mackerel soup.
